session_selection.time_basis: First and last persisted events in the selected root tree's workspace-local bundled Codex rollout/SQLite records.
session_selection.rationale: Primary Codex root records the benchmark run at /workspace on codex/dsv4_flash/init, has 20 direct spawned descendants, and continuously covers implementation, runs, report compilation, and the terminal response. No other root is selected.
